subject: Trading
title: The Fear-Greed Cycle
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Fear-Greed Cycle.

hook.text: Markets swing between two emotions: fear and greed. When one peaks, the other is about to take over.

buildup.text: Greed drives prices higher as traders pile in, chasing gains. Fear crashes prices as they rush for the exit.

discovery.text: CNN's Fear and Greed Index tracks seven factors to measure which emotion dominates the market right now.

twist.text: The best buying opportunities appear at peak fear. The worst entries happen at peak greed. Most do the opposite.

climax.text: Warren Buffett's rule: 'Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.'

punchline.text: The crowd's emotion is your contrarian signal.

quiz.question: According to Buffett, when should you buy?
options: When others are fearful and prices are low
